in_hindi.long_meaning: काधर नाम से बताते हैं कि वह सर्दर या कोई प्रभावशाली व्यक्ति है जिसका करने वाले समस्यों को हटाने वाला कुशल है।

in_marathi.name: Kadhar
in_marathi.meaning: हिंदू नाव म्हणजे Strength, Power, Brave
in_marathi.long_meaning: Kadhar हे एक हिंदू नाव आहे जे भारतीय संस्कृतीत खोल आध्यात्मिक महत्त्व ठेवते। Kadhar is a name derived from the Sanskrit word 'Kadru', which means 'mountain' or 'strength'. In Hindu mythology, Kadru is the name of a serpent queen who gave birth to the Nagas, the divine serpents. Kadhar is a name that signifies strength, power, and bravery. It is a unisex name that is suitable for both boys and girls.
